hints.title: Hall Event Chronology
hints.text: Sort the events per hall chronologically by start date and end date.

hints.title: Island Boundary Flagging
hints.text: A new non-overlapping interval island begins whenever the current start_day exceeds the maximum end_day of all preceding events for that hall.

hints.title: Island Group Aggregation
hints.text: Compute a cumulative sum of the new island indicators to assign group keys, then aggregate with min start_day and max end_day.

hints.title: Window Function Gaps and Islands Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
WITH HallEventsWithIsNewEvent AS (
    SELECT 
        hall_id, 
        start_day, 
        end_day,
        CASE 
            WHEN start_day > MAX(end_day) OVER (
                PARTITION BY hall_id 
                ORDER BY start_day, end_day DESC 
                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
            ) THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS is_new_event
    FROM HallEvents
),
HallEventsWithGroupId AS (
    SELECT 
        hall_id, 
        start_day, 
        end_day,
        SUM(is_new_event) OVER (
            PARTITION BY hall_id 
            ORDER BY start_day, end_day DESC
            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) AS group_id
    FROM HallEventsWithIsNewEvent
)
SELECT 
    hall_id, 
    MIN(start_day) AS start_day, 
    MAX(end_day) AS end_day
FROM HallEventsWithGroupId
GROUP BY hall_id, group_id;
```

complexity.notes: Sorting followed by running window maximum and grouping.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterative line-by-line interval merges in SQL require non-standard recursive loops.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory to materialize interval window states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies standard window-based gaps and islands interval merging pattern.
